changes.evidence: His British Army/SAS service (raids in Helmand) is pre-series backstory; no title on file shows him in the army. The earliest on-file moment (S2 episode 5 flashback) is already Wesley recruiting him for Fisk in the US.

Her S.H.I.E.L.D. service was before her first episode: after S.H.I.E.L.D. fell, Coulson failed to bring her back, and her first appearance (S2 episode 3) opens with HYDRA kidnapping and brainwashing her. Her later stay at the Playground was under armed guard, not membership, and she then betrayed S.H.I.E.L.D. for Ward.
After her Terrigenesis in S2, Gordon takes her to Afterlife. She lives there with a transitioner, accepts her gift and works as the community's fortune teller, until Jiaying kills her in episode 43.

In S7 ('Stolen'), in a changed 1983, the young S.H.I.E.L.D. recruit Garrett agrees to join Nathaniel Malick's team. Malick brings him into the seized Afterlife and gives him Gordon's powers, and Hand later kills him. The wiki lists Nathaniel Malick's Crew as his affiliation in that timeline. Uses the season title S7, which this record does not use yet.

In S3 (episode 62, per the record's own step), Daisy and Hive put James through Terrigenesis. Hive's dust makes him loyal, and he serves Hive's army (Hive's HYDRA, the group used for Hive and Giyera) through the S3 finale. In S4 he deals with the Watchdogs. Note: his loyalty to Hive came from Hive's mind control.

After S3 he is arrested for corruption. In Slingshot he has escaped prison as a former officer and has made a deal with the Watchdogs to sell them a stolen 0-8-4, and he dies at their meeting. The wiki lists the Watchdogs as his current affiliation and puts him in its Watchdogs Members category.

After S.H.I.E.L.D. rescues him from Hive (S3 finale), he works with S.H.I.E.L.D. on Aida, and Director Mace keeps the LMD program going under S.H.I.E.L.D. supervision (the wiki lists S.H.I.E.L.D., formerly). Later in S4 he deceives S.H.I.E.L.D. and goes to Ellen Nadeer and the Watchdogs, giving them mission plans (wiki section 'Joining the Watchdogs'). The record has no groups at all. Season titles are used to match the other records for this show.

owner_calls.question: Should Cal get a HYDRA stage (and/or an Afterlife stage) in S2 before or around the Slicing Talons?
options: Keep as is: Slicing Talons S2, then Independent S2
Add HYDRA S2 before Slicing Talons
Add HYDRA S2 and Afterlife S2 (after the Talons)
owner_calls.evidence: In S2 Cal goes to Whitehall to offer an alliance, works on the Diviner and the splinter bomb, and leads a HYDRA team to Australia (wiki section 'Work at Hydra'). He was only ever using them to get revenge, and the wiki's affiliation list leaves HYDRA out. After the Talons, Gordon takes him to Afterlife, where Jiaying lets him stay, but he is not an Inhuman member. At the end of S2 his memory is wiped and he starts life over as Dr. Winslow with his own veterinary practice.

owner_calls.question: Should Eli's S4 army count as joining the Chinatown Crew?
options: Keep as is: Momentum Labs S4, then Independent S4
Add Chinatown Crew S4 as the final stage
owner_calls.evidence: In S4, after gaining Darkhold powers, Eli builds a small army out of the Chinatown Crew and South Ridge convicts and makes the Crew's base his headquarters. The wiki lists the Chinatown Crew as his affiliation. He leads them rather than joining them.
